Conservativeness means L^{h,λ}1=0, not 1. The stated Γ disagrees with the paper's own definition Γ(f,g)=L(fg)-fLg-gLf, and h^{-1}Γ(h,f) under it does not give the claimed identity.

issues.failure_explanation: Under GBM, log x_T ~ N(log x_0 - T/2, T), so p_T collapses toward 0 with entropy tending to -∞. Hence KL(p_T||q_0) grows without bound for any q_0 with bounded density, and enlarging T makes the error bound of cor:error_bound/thm:numerical_error vacuous. In addition, p_t is supported on the orthant, so it is not strictly positive on R^d, and D(x) degenerates at the boundary. This violates ass:regularity_alpha and ass:regularity_diffusion.

issues.failure_explanation: Applying prop:augmented_generator requires f(s,·), ∂_s f(s,·) ∈ dom(L_s). This is not implied by C_c^∞ ⊂ dom of the augmented generator. Without it, nothing excludes time-direction diffusion, time jumps, or a time drift ≠1 in the augmented Courrège triplet. Separately, Courrège gives only positive semidefinite D. Pure-jump processes (the paper's own jump and α-stable models, with D≡0) contradict 'positive definite'.
